xBRIEFInfo.description: Occupancy-first ritual writes plus fail-open compact stale-mark. Issue #3769 with its accepted design-critique synthesis is SoT.

plan.title: occupancy-first ritual writes, and a fail-open compact stale-mark

narratives.Description: Close two paths by which a session that does not own a worktree lease can rewrite the owner ritual state. Path 1: a denied foreign write must leave the owner ritual bytes untouched. Path 2: a compact stays always-allow, and when the acting identity cannot be bound the stale-mark is written anyway (fail-open).
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue #3769, child of tracker #3613. Round-1 panel of three: 5441671854, 5441678318, 5441679066. First lean 5441712084. Successor lean 5455499276 resolved the one residual by operator amend. Verified-claims table 5455502197. Bind line 5455503730. Chip design-critique:triage-ready.
narratives.Overview: Measured at 52a5fddc: packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts calls verifySessionRitual at :1110 and evaluateOccupancyWriteGate at :1143 and :1254, so the ritual persist happens before the occupancy verdict. The compact stale-mark has one seam-injectable call site at dispatcher.ts:1726. Reordering so occupancy or a no-write inspect completes first closes Path 1; the fail-open policy at that single call site settles Path 2.
narratives.UserStory: As the session that owns a worktree lease, I want a foreign or unidentified session to be unable to rewrite my ritual state, so that I am never locked out of my own worktree by another agent write.
narratives.When: When a foreign session write is denied by occupancy, the owner ritual-state bytes are unchanged on a fresh record; when a compact cannot bind its actor, the owner re-arm flag is still set; when occupancy would deny, no ritual persist has already happened.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Operator amend 2026-08-28 selects FAIL-OPEN for the compact unavailable-identity case: markRitualStaleAfterCompact writes even when the actor cannot be bound. Accepted cost, stated: an unidentified compact will re-arm the owner. Rationale on the record: the compact path has no issue context and runs inside a hook budget (#3739), so a skipped write has no surface where a human reliably sees it. DROPPED as filed: the AC2 disjunct routing compact through the mutation gates (compact must NOT enter inspectMutationGates, which would re-run Path 1 writes or occupancy-deny an owner compact, #2113); and the AC1 limb scoping the write to the resolved actor (do not retitle session_id on a denied path). Ritual-state locking remains a decision item and is NOT in scope. Path 1 is the denied-write mutation; Path 2 is the owner lockout; do not design one as the other.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Reorder the dispatcher so occupancy, or a no-write inspect, completes before any ritual persist, including the forward-HEAD rebind. 2) Make the compact stale-mark fail open at its single seam call site. 3) Tests: byte-identical owner ritual state after a denied foreign write on a fresh record; unidentified compact sets the owner re-arm flag; stop stubbing the ritual verify in occupancy tests so Path 1 is visible. 4) CHANGELOG. Closes #3769.
narratives.OriginDivergence: The refutation target as filed does not hold: both measured paths exist, and each filed acceptance criterion was an OR-pair with one unsafe limb. The unsafe limbs are dropped above rather than implemented. Field note 2026-08-28: an unbound or foreign-rooted actor is routine rather than exotic. Two live instances this session are recorded on #3861 and #3794 comment 5455387406.

items.title: Occupancy or no-write inspect completes before any ritual persist

narrative.When: When a foreign session write is denied by occupancy on a fresh record, the owner ritual-state file is byte-identical afterwards, and no session_id retitle has occurred on the denied path.
narrative.Acceptance: When a foreign session write is denied by occupancy on a fresh record, the owner ritual-state file is byte-identical afterwards, and no session_id retitle has occurred on the denied path.

items.title: Compact stale-mark fails open when the actor cannot be bound

narrative.When: When a compact runs and the acting identity cannot be bound, the compact verdict stays allow, the stale-mark is still written so the owner re-arm flag is set, and the compact path does not enter inspectMutationGates.
narrative.Acceptance: When a compact runs and the acting identity cannot be bound, the compact verdict stays allow, the stale-mark is still written so the owner re-arm flag is set, and the compact path does not enter inspectMutationGates.
